constraints_found.constraint: Preference: fresh and light, not greasy or heavy (Brooke)
constraints_found.source_line: brooke: "just not the greasy, heavy kind for me. something fresh and light"
maya: "fresh is fine. CHEAP is mandatory. one dollar sign max, it's all for the trip fund"

constraints_found.constraint: Strict diet: Mina is vegetarian, so the venue needs real vegetarian pizza (picking meat off does not count)
constraints_found.source_line: brooke: "wait, mina, you're vegetarian! you told me in class. picking it off doesn't count" (reinforced by maya: "we are going somewhere with real veggie pizza")

elimination.campus_slice_society: Every pizza comes with meat and they won't make one without: deal-breaker for Mina's vegetarian diet.
elimination.campus_quad_pizza_co: Has veggie slices and is cheap, but deep, doughy and greasy: misses Brooke's fresh and light preference (-1 star).
elimination.campus_green_bean_cafe: Vegetarian-friendly, light and cheap, but no pizza: misses the pizza craving (-1 star), and the chat explicitly rejects Mina 'just getting a salad'.
elimination.campus_basil_hearth: Pizza, thin and light with fresh toppings, half the menu is veggie, $ and cheap per the review: meets everything.

notes: Fair and well built. The vegetarian clue is nicely disguised: Mina downplays it ('i can always just pick the pepperoni off') and Brooke has to surface it, so a careless reader might miss it. Then Maya restates it in the next line, which makes it fairly easy to catch. Each decoy fails on exactly one constraint (Slice Society: vegetarian; Quad: light; Green Bean: pizza), which makes for clean deduction. All four venues are $, so the budget clue does no filtering work in this level. No contradictions found.
